name: shimura-steps

leaves.name: shimuraThm1AsPrinted
leaves.doc: Shimura's construction J/C, with C the images of the integral elements of the rational annihilator; (i) the quotient condition, (ii) intertwining for every positive index, (iii) the dimension, and uniqueness up to a Q-isomorphism.
leaves.source: Shimura, On the factors of the jacobian variety of a modular function field, J. Math. Soc. Japan 25 (1973), 523-544, Theorem 1 and its construction; manuscript L770-773, L11053-11057.

leaves.name: shimuraHeckeRelations
leaves.doc: Composite Hecke correspondences act over Q on the same Jacobian with the stated divisor-class formula, agree with the existing prime operators, and satisfy the coprime and prime-power laws.
leaves.flag: on-the-spot: composite Jacobian operators, normalization dictionary and multiplication laws
leaves.source: Shimura 1973 pp. 525-526 (Hecke ring and action; AI page read). The comparison with the kernel model is on-the-spot.

leaves.name: sameDimSurjectiveFinite
leaves.doc: Every surjective homomorphism between equal-dimensional abelian varieties over Q is finite. This is the remaining dimension step for projection-compatible uniqueness.
leaves.flag: on-the-spot: finiteness of the induced surjective homomorphism in step 3
leaves.source: On-the-spot argument from the dimension of the generic fibre, translation of geometric fibres, and proper quasi-finite implies finite; applied to Shimura 1973, Thm. 1, p. 526.
